# Amir Off

> Personal portfolio of Amir Off — Senior Frontend and Full-Stack Engineer specializing in React, TypeScript, and modern web platforms.

This site is a single-page portfolio. Section anchors below map to in-page content. Prefer linked profiles and the Medium blog for deeper technical writing and project history.

## Pages

- [Home](https://amiroff.org/): Portfolio landing page with about, projects, blog highlights, and contact
- [About](https://amiroff.org/#profile): Background, experience, and focus areas
- [Portfolio](https://amiroff.org/#portfolio): Public GitHub repositories and contribution graph
- [Blog](https://amiroff.org/#blog): Recent Medium posts
- [Contact](https://amiroff.org/#contact): Contact form and social links

## Profiles

- [GitHub](https://github.com/amir0ff): Open-source projects and code
- [DedSecLabs](https://github.com/DedSecLabs): Organization repositories
- [Medium](https://medium.com/@amir0ff): Technical articles
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/amir0ff): Professional profile and resume
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@amir0ff): Video content
